Skip.description: Immediately end your turn without drawing a card.

Attack.description: End your turn without drawing. Force the next player to take 2 turns.

Defuse.description: You don't explode, you can put the bomb back in the deck

Predict.description: Peek at the top 3 cards from the Draw Pile. Put them back in the same order.

Nope.description: Stop any action except for an Exploding Kitten or a Defuse Card. Play at any time.

Favor.description: Force any other player to give you 1 card from their hand. They choose which card.

Bomb.description: If you don't defuse this bomb you will explode and die.
